div.div:
Core rules:
1. Session has many items, but only one item is LIVE.
2. Each item has one WebSocket auction room.
3. Bid order is enforced by SQS FIFO with MessageGroupId=item_id.
4. Wallet uses full bid amount hold. Previous highest hold is released when outbid.
5. Anti-sniping: bid in last 30s => extend by 60s.
6. Finished item history hidden from normal users; admin can audit all bid_events.
7. Seller cannot bid on own item; admin can pause/resume.
